combo_label: School Days × Baking & Cakes × The Wild West

entries.clue: Sugar beaten with a drop of water, spread over a fairy cake
Living fungus whose bubbles of gas lift a whole loaf
Single-serving sponge in a paper case, crowned with a swirl of buttercream
Lesson space of paired tables, a big board and a wall of artwork
Canvas-topped cart hauled west by oxen in a rolling train
Adding and taking away, worked in a column down the page
Jangling spiked wheels strapped at the heels of riding boots
Band of armed townsfolk riding out together to run down a gang
Arena contest of bull riding and roping, won for a prize buckle
Group of young singers rehearsing for the carol service
Pavement game of numbered squares, a pebble and one-legged jumps
Panicked mass charge of hooves that flattens everything ahead
